definitions.explanation: In grammar, the verb form used to give direct commands or orders. In Japanese, formed by changing the verb ending (e.g., {食|た}べろ, {行|い}け).

examples.japanese: {命令形|めいれいけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{口調|くちょう}→口調：11803_kuchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。

⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{命令形|めいれいけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧な⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{好|この}む→好む：02103_konomu⟧。
examples.english: The Japanese imperative form is more commonly used by men, while women tend to prefer polite expressions.

notes:
A grammar term composed of ⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧ (command, order) and {形|けい} (form). Refers to the conjugated form of Japanese verbs used for direct commands.

IMPERATIVE FORM BY VERB TYPE:
- ⟦{一段|いちだん}→一段：08951_ichidan⟧ verbs: stem + ろ (⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ → ⟦{食|た}べろ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧)
- ⟦{五段|ごだん}→五段：28275_godan⟧ verbs: え-row ending (⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ → ⟦{行|い}け→行く：00119_iku⟧, ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ → ⟦{読|よ}め→読む：00426_yomu⟧)
- ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ → しろ
- ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ → ⟦{来|こ}い→来る：00254_kuru⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {命令形|めいれいけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change into the imperative form
- {命令形|めいれいけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say in the imperative form
- {命令形|めいれいけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}→活用：02620_katsuyou⟧: conjugation of the imperative form

USAGE:
The bare imperative is considered rough and masculine in Japanese. It appears in sports cheering, emergency situations, and casual male speech. In formal or polite contexts, ～て⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ or ～⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧ is used instead.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{肯定形|こうていけい}→肯定形：22947_kouteikei⟧: affirmative form
- ⟦{否定形|ひていけい}→否定形：11500_hiteikei⟧: negative form
- {活用形|かつようけい}: conjugated form — the general term for all verb forms
- ⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧: command, order — the base noun
